}}'''Leyn''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Leyn|Leyn}} She can [[Channel]] quite strongly.{{ref||Leyn}}

==Strength and Abilities==
When [[Cadsuane]] passes [[Edarra]] and Leyn in a hallway in the [[Sun Palace]] she is clearly irritated that such strong channelers are not in the White Tower. Because Edarra's strength level is {{opsl|18}} it can be assumed that Leyn's level is very close.

This strength is more than enough to [[Travel]].

== Activities ==
She is one of the many Wise Ones who settle into [[Cairhien]] after the battle with the [[Shaido]].

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
